### macOS: opening the app on first launch

This build is not Apple-signed, so Gatekeeper blocks the very first open. This is expected and the app is safe to run.

1. Open the DMG and drag OverSteer into Applications.
2. Try to open it once. macOS will refuse ("damaged" / "can't be opened").
3. Go to System Settings → Privacy & Security, scroll down to Security, and click **Open Anyway**, then **Open** in the confirmation dialog.
4. It opens normally from then on. (On older macOS versions, right-clicking the app and choosing Open works instead of step 3.)
